subject: Throughput validation & sizing kickoff for Dedicated pool
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.inference>
To: Emily Thomas <emily.thomas@trinityhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
Date: 2028-06-18T15:12:00Z
Subject: Recap: discovery call + suggested next step (throughput validation)

Hi Emily —

Thanks again for a great conversation today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment before the sizing call: 

- Goal: validate Trinity Health's peak concurrent request shape and per-request token throughput so we can size a Dedicated GPU pool and propose a cost/latency plan.
- Info you shared today: batch-style patient-summary generation (avg ~350 tokens), expected concurrency ~20 steady with spikes to ~60, SLA target p95 latency under 600ms for the online path.
- What we need for the next call: a short sample request log (anonymized) or a synthetic profile (tokens/request + concurrency), and confirmation of whether any requests need tool-calls or retrieval prior to generation.

Proposed next meeting: 60min technical sizing + throughput validation. Ben (solutions) will lead the walkthrough of load profile and test plan; Marissa (CS) will join for deployment/runbook discussion.

A couple of slots that work for our team next week:
- Tue 2028-06-20 09:00–10:00 PT
- Wed 2028-06-21 13:00–14:00 PT
- Thu 2028-06-22 11:00–12:00 PT

I attached the short discovery notes and a sample CSV template you can use for the throughput profile. If none of the times work, share a couple windows and we’ll accommodate.

Attachments: discovery-notes-20280618.pdf (application/pdf), throughput-sample.csv (text/csv)

Thanks —
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.inference
+1 (415) 555-0192

Neha Kapoor

Redwood Inference

From: Emily Thomas <emily.thomas@trinityhealth.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.inference>
Cc: OPS Team <ops@trinityhealth.com>
Date: 2028-06-18T18:04:00Z
Subject: Re: Recap: discovery call + suggested next step (throughput validation)

Hi Neha —

Thanks for the recap and for the template. Helping to confirm a few details from our side so you can prep:

- Short profile: average payload ~320 tokens, 90% of requests are single-turn generation, about 10% include a retrieval step which adds ~120ms before generation.
- Current steady concurrency: ~18–22, with known daily batch jobs that create ~75 concurrent short bursts for ~3–6 minutes.
- P95 latency target (end-to-end) is 600ms; we’d accept slightly higher during batch windows if cost/throughput tradeoffs are needed.

We can make Tue 2028-06-20 09:00 PT work. I’ve looped Ops (ops@trinityhealth.com) so they can confirm whether they can provide a scrubbed request log ahead of time.

Also attaching a short internal note that lists our privacy constraints for logs (PII must be removed).

Best,
Emily
Emily Thomas
Director, AI Ops
Trinity Health
emily.thomas@trinityhealth.com

Great — thanks for confirming Tue at 09:00 PT. I’ll own the technical deep-dive. Quick agenda so the call stays focused:

1) 10m: introductions + scope (Neha)
2) 15m: Trinity load/profile review (Emily / Ops)
3) 25m: Redwood test plan and estimated pool sizing (Ben) — live run-through of a synthetic load profile and expected p95 projections
4) 10m: runbook, fallbacks, and next steps (Marissa)

Prep checklist for Trinity before the call (helps us avoid an extra follow-up):
- Scrubbed sample request log OR completed throughput-sample.csv (attached)
- A short note on external retrieval calls and typical latency for those (if used)
- Confirmation on whether you need on-prem/air-gapped constraints for the test environment

I attached a short agenda file (tech-deep-dive-agenda.md) and will prepare a small synthetic runner that mimics the profile you shared. If Ops can paste a stripped-down log into a shared Drive doc (link below) that’d be ideal.

Shared prep doc (example): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1xPrepExample

See you Tue 09:00 PT — I’ll send a calendar invite and a short test token before the call so we can run a 5–10 minute live profile.
